svg.title: One-Punch Commits
svg.desc: 909 contributions from 2025-10-05 to 2026-10-05. Pixel Saitama lands a bright punch impact and sends a yellow-orange pressure wave across the calendar, with a smaller aftershock fading behind it. Every contribution square returns to its real date and intensity.
svg.metadata: Saitama pixel sprite credited to Hacker93, shared by SantinoP: https://scratch.mit.edu/projects/305192876/. CC BY-SA 2.0: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.0/. Frame timing, shockwave and real contribution calendar arranged for this profile. See assets/saitama/CREDITS.md.
